dimension.description: The defect class this seat hunts. The key the review phase is split on.

question.description: The one question this seat answers, stated so that a NO is possible.

look_at.description: Paths this dimension should read. A pointer, not a payload — the seat opens them itself, and what it opens is recorded.

dimensions.description: The review dimensions, each already pointed at its own slice.

declared_purpose.description: What the change says this mechanism is for.

callers.description: Where it is REACHED from, as found in the tree — empty is a finding, not a blank.

mechanisms.description: Each new or changed mechanism, and what calls it. The North Star this repo keeps failing: a mechanism that works, has passing tests, and is never reached.

new_laws.description: Test files and law names the change adds, so a reviewer can ask of each whether it could ever have been red.

unread.description: Parts of the diff this survey did NOT open. An honest gap, stated, rather than a survey that implies completeness.
